title: driver / driver.pr_updated (v1) data payload
description: Driver (system of record for the racing identity) confirmed a new canonical all-time personal record for a driver, computed authoritatively from its own lap history (Story 3.4, FR11 / Q&A Round 37 / Q37.4). Published to the 'driver.events' exchange with routing key 'driver.pr_updated' — one event per real change to the canonical PR (idempotent: an already-confirmed PR re-publishes nothing). Timing consumes it to refresh its local PR copy (FR37); Frontend updates its read-model.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId issued by Identity. Lowercase canonical UUID v4 (version nibble 4, variant nibble [89ab]); the pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

lapTimeMs.description: The confirmed canonical all-time best lap time for this driver, in milliseconds.

setAt.description: When the record-setting lap happened (the 'at' of that lap). RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (AR9). The pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).
